title: Lead 5: fertilizer target-tile eligibility timing

variant.change: age >= c['first'] - 1  ->  age >= c['first'] - 3 (fertilizer eligibility opens 2 days earlier per tile). Single-line change.

primary_test_method: mini_engine.evaluate() direct head-to-head (same harness evolve/cascade.py uses), seed-matched, both seats -- used as PRIMARY test from the start per the lesson from Lead 4's false positive.

cross_design_corroboration.note: Consistent direction with head-to-head result, unlike Lead 4 where the two designs disagreed.

pre_registered_predictions.detail: Mechanical, deterministic consequence of the eligibility-window change; not separately re-measured via trace mining.

pre_registered_predictions.prediction: Realized production/fertilizer application increases in expected direction

pre_registered_predictions.detail: Batch 2 (fresh seeds 201-300) replicates batch 1 with consistent sign, larger magnitude and significance.

rng_side_effect_audit.detail: _fert_eligible() is a pure function of crop age/growth constants/fertilized_until_day; no RNG call in it or its only caller (_build_sweep's fert tier). FERTILIZE is a deterministic engine action.

recommendation: None -- CONFIRMED per this investigation's own bar, but explicitly diagnostic evidence only. NOT promoted, merged, or wired into the evolution pipeline in any way, per standing constraints.
